## Clicker 1 (Kirchhoff)

**Question:** Which setup produces an absorption spectrum?

A) Hot dense object  
B) Hot thin gas  
C) Cool gas in front of a hot dense source  

**Answer:** C

## Clicker 2 (inversion idea)

**Question:** If a gas shows an emission line at 589 nm, where will it absorb?

A) 589 nm  
B) 5890 nm  
C) It depends on temperature; there is no fixed wavelength  

**Answer:** A

## Short answer (pattern matching)

“Why is identifying an element by one line risky? Explain in one or two sentences.”

## Exit ticket

“In your own words: what is the difference between a continuous spectrum and an absorption spectrum?”
